label: English
siteDescription: Lint and format Pug templates in Vue single-file components with ESLint. Your vue/* rules run on Pug, eslint --fix formats the Pug, and every fix is checked so it never breaks a template.

demo.label: Example: eslint --fix on a Pug template
demo.hint: Hover a squiggle to read the warning.
demo.doneDetail: {count} fixed by eslint --fix, and the template renders the same.

howItWorks.label: How eslint-plugin-pug-vue lints a Pug template
howItWorks.tokenizerText: turns the Pug into the tokens Vue expects from HTML
howItWorks.parseOut: gives a Vue template AST, plus the Pug tree
howItWorks.vueRulesText: read the Vue AST, as on an HTML template
howItWorks.pugRulesText: read the Pug tree: indentation, attributes, quotes…
howItWorks.lintOut: problems, each maybe with a fix
howItWorks.suppressText: drops vue/* messages that misreport on Pug, only inside Pug templates
howItWorks.guardText: applies each fix to a copy, parses it again with pug-lint-parser and compares the structure
howItWorks.sameText: the fix is applied by eslint --fix or fix-on-save
howItWorks.changedText: the fix is dropped; the warning stays for you to fix by hand
